Title: Mariel, Rotschreck and Dawn Operation [Hey, Scalpel and rules mongers]

Messages.Author: Justin
Messages.Body:
Please help me rules-mongers!!!!

I understand that if I play Dawn Operation all damage is aggravated in
the ensuing combat and then someone can play Rotschreck on either
combatant because, even if striking for hand damage, they are attempting
an aggravated strike (exception: S:Dodge or S:CE)

What happens with Mariel Lady Thunder. If she taps, both combatants
take a point of aggravated damage, right? Can I now play Rotschreck on
her because she is the source of the damage?

Also, what about retainers. If, during the Dawn Operation combat, I
target a Sub Machine Gun Strike at Long Range at the opponents retainer
(eg Mr. Winthrop) does that still count as aggravated damage because
retainers can't take aggr. dam? Could someone play Rotschreck on me
then?

James Coupe.

>I understand that if I play Dawn Operation all damage is aggravated in
>the ensuing combat and then someone can play Rotschreck on either
>combatant because, even if striking for hand damage, they are attempting
>an aggravated strike (exception: S:Dodge or S:CE)

Yes.

>What happens with Mariel Lady Thunder. If she taps, both combatants
>take a point of aggravated damage, right? Can I now play Rotschreck on
>her because she is the source of the damage?

No. Mariel's text reads as follows:
"Tap Mariel before range is chosen to end any combat that does not
involve her. All participating minions and retainers suffer one
damage."
As effects are resolved in order of their listing on the card, Mariel
would end combat, and then deal damage to all minions and retainers,
which would be non-aggravated. Even beyond that, however, Rotshreck
can only be used on a vampire attempting to use aggravated damage as a
strike in combat(or so I believe); since Mariel is not striking, much
less using aggravated damage, and since she is not even involved in
the combat, she is immune.

>Also, what about retainers. If, during the Dawn Operation combat, I
>target a Sub Machine Gun Strike at Long Range at the opponents retainer
>(eg Mr. Winthrop) does that still count as aggravated damage because
>retainers can't take aggr. dam? Could someone play Rotschreck on me
>then?

Rotshreck, as it reads from raw card text, is a nightmare(of trying to
figure out what it actually does, at least in the Jyhad version).
However, if you are using the interpretation that it is played on the
vampire trying to use aggravated damage, then yes, it may be used.

Alec Chang

Sorry to have missed all of this discussion, but from the looks of
things, a little clarification is in order.

Mariel's damage is viewed as coming from her, but it occurs after
combat is ended, so would not be aggravated during a Dawn Operation.

If it were aggravated (for whatever reason), Rotschreck *could* be played
on her, per updated card text:

4) Rotschreck should be read as follows: "Play on a vampire that attempts to
inflict aggravated damage. Combat ends, and that vampire goes into torpor.
During the vampire's controller's next untap phase, burn this card instead of
untapping the vampire."

Hi Robert,

the official rulings that are published in LSJ's errata collection name
this for Rotschreck

Rotschreck - Master Out-Of-Turn:
Should be read as follows: "Play on a vampire that attempts to inflict

aggravated damage. Combat ends, and that vampire goes into torpor. During
the vampire's controller's next untap phase, burn this card instead of

untapping the vampire." [RTR]
Is played when strikes are chosen, not during resolution. [TOM 960521]

Especially the second point seems to be somewhat contradictory since DBR
*is* played during resolution and the very same errata names Rotschreck
to work against it (as follows):

Damage Modification Cards
Must be played before the end of the Choose Strike phase in order to affect
the current strike. [RTR]
Ammo cards are played before any strikes take effect regardless of whether
those strikes deal damage or not. Thus, if a vampire who plays Dragon's
Breath Rounds is slammed by Rotschreck, the combat will end before either
strike does anything. [RTR]

(this may be the source for contradicting rulings from the RTR of late)

So in fact there seems to be some desperate need for clarification with
regards to Rotschreck.

Michael
